en.moment_body: Most goalkeepers are years retired by forty. This one kept a clean sheet against the eventual champions, then dragged a debutant nation into extra time. A whole life of waiting, spent in ninety-minute instalments, for a tournament nobody thought he would reach.
en.meta_description: Premium heavyweight cotton tee. Aos 40, piece IM–10 of the MOMUTO Iconic Series: a 40-year-old goalkeeper's tournament, drawn in expressive sketch illustration.
